description: g16dump benchmark suite: mathematical validation, Ni(II) ligand-field models, metalloporphyrins across three first-row transition metals, and the legacy Fe-porphyrin regression case.
notes: Entries with geometry_status='placeholder' still need an optimized structure. Everything else about them -- charge, multiplicity, reference, basis and active window -- is specified, and the window is validated.
Windows are 1-based inclusive MO indices, matching Gaussian's Window=(first,last).
The Gaussian route section is UNVERIFIED until a real .mat has been produced and inspected; see gaussian/README.md.
The Fe-porphine and Co-porphine entries exist so the workflow is demonstrably not Ni-specific.

systems.name: h2o_rhf
systems.purpose: closed shell; a full-space dump is feasible for cross-checking

systems.name: ch2_singlet
systems.purpose: closed-shell partner for the singlet-triplet gap

systems.name: nicl4_sqplanar_m1
systems.purpose: Ni(II) d8 NiCl4(2-), sqplanar, multiplicity 1. Square-planar ligand fields favour the singlet and tetrahedral the triplet, so the pair is a chemically meaningful ordering test.

systems.name: nicl4_sqplanar_m3
systems.purpose: Ni(II) d8 NiCl4(2-), sqplanar, multiplicity 3. Square-planar ligand fields favour the singlet and tetrahedral the triplet, so the pair is a chemically meaningful ordering test.

systems.name: nicl4_tetrahedral_m1
systems.purpose: Ni(II) d8 NiCl4(2-), tetrahedral, multiplicity 1. Square-planar ligand fields favour the singlet and tetrahedral the triplet, so the pair is a chemically meaningful ordering test.

systems.name: nicl4_tetrahedral_m3
systems.purpose: Ni(II) d8 NiCl4(2-), tetrahedral, multiplicity 3. Square-planar ligand fields favour the singlet and tetrahedral the triplet, so the pair is a chemically meaningful ordering test.

systems.name: ni_porphine_m1
systems.purpose: Ni-porphine singlet: the smallest realistic metalloporphyrin, well before any PAP substituents
systems.geometry: PLACEHOLDER needs an optimized geometry; composition and active space are specified: Ni-porphine, NiN4C20H12
